description: CafeFinder Phase 1.5 evaluation dataset. Each test case is a YouTube link with the ground-truth cafe/restaurant the link refers to. Used by evaluation/run_eval.py to compute Top-1 / Top-3 accuracy and confidence-calibration metrics.

match_strategy.fallback: place_name fuzzy match >= 0.85 AND city present in actual address

instructions: Replace each URL placeholder with a real YouTube/Shorts link that clearly shows ONE cafe or restaurant.
Fill in expected.google_place_id by searching the cafe on Google Maps and copying the place ID from the share link or via the Places API. This is the gold-standard match key.
If you don't have place_id, leave it null; the matcher will fall back to name+city.
Aim for 50 cases. Mix difficulty levels: easy (chain with name in title), medium (name in description only), hard (no name, only visual clues).
Tag each case with attributes for slicing metrics: chain, indie, hidden_name, hindi_speech, ocr_required, etc.

test_cases.notes: Cafe name appears clearly in video title and signage.
Patisserie chain with multiple branches — branch disambiguation test.
Chain test — Third Wave has many branches. Tests area-aware ranking.
Global chain — must pick the right branch.
Hyderabad chain — many branches, test area disambiguation.
Iconic Hyderabad Irani cafe — name should be unambiguous.
Name not in title — must come from description or hashtags.
Negative test — video has no clear cafe name. Should return low confidence and ask for screenshot.
